title: Mai Gina Ceto Mai Tsayayye
intro: Mutum mai matuƙar haƙuri da kuma cikakken yakini, wannan mutum ya sadaukar da shekaru marasa adadi ga wani aiki na allahntaka, yana fuskantar zagi da ƙin yarda ba tare da ɓata lokaci ba. Labarinsu shaida ce mai ƙarfi ta imani yayin da ake fuskantar rashin imani mai yawa, wanda ya ƙare a cikin wani muhimmin lamari da ya sake fasalin duniya.
clues: Na sadaukar da tsawon lokaci mai tsawo a rayuwata ina kiran mutanena zuwa ga bauta wa Allah.
Mutanena suna yi mini ba'a suna zargina da kuskure da hauka a bayyane.
An umarce ni da in gina wani abu da ya yi kama da ba a saba gani ba ga al'ummar da ba ta da iyaka.
Kaɗan ne kawai suka yi imani suka kuma haɗu da ni da iyalina a wannan gini na musamman.
Na ɗauki nau'i-nau'i na kowace halitta mai rai a cikin jirgin, kamar yadda Allah ya umurta.
Babban ambaliya ya mamaye duniya, wanda ya ceci waɗanda ke tare da ni a cikin jirgina kawai, yayin da ɗana ya mutu saboda rashin imaninsa.

arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٔـٰتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًۭا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًۭا
verse: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers. (71:25)
